resources.string: Runs on the NPU, with the build for %1$s
The NPU build did not run on this phone, so the CPU runs it. The NPU gets another try after the next app or system update.
The NPU build is a %1$s download.
Where the search model reads text

NPU downloads a build of the text model made for this phone\'s chip, from Google\'s EmbeddingGemma 2 releases on Hugging Face, and runs it on the NPU, the chip\'s part for machine learning. It puts texts in the same places as the CPU model, so nothing is read again. The NPU uses the same runtime files as on-device AI with Compute set to NPU, and they download with it when they are missing. On a Snapdragon, a build that downloads them asks you to accept Qualcomm\'s licence first.\n\nPictures are always read on the CPU. If the NPU build does not load or stops, the CPU model takes over and stays in use on this phone until the next app or system update. CPU deletes the NPU build. CPU is the default.

NPU downloads a build of Whisper Tiny made for this phone\'s chip, from litert-community on Hugging Face, and runs it on the NPU, the chip\'s part for machine learning. It is the same Whisper Tiny model, converted for the NPU, and the Whisper Tiny you downloaded stays on the phone. The NPU uses the same runtime files as on-device AI with Compute set to NPU, and they download with it when they are missing. On a Snapdragon, a build that downloads them asks you to accept Qualcomm\'s licence first.\n\nIf the NPU build does not load or stops during a phrase, the phrase goes to the CPU, and the CPU runs Whisper Tiny on this phone until the next app or system update. Other Whisper models are not affected. CPU deletes the NPU build. CPU is the default.
